comparison: same 300 x 300 micrometre square physical aperture; only the motif and Bravais lattice differ
square_motif: one central main hole and one independently placed diagonal satellite
triangular_motif: one central main hole and two independently placed diagonal-direction satellites
period_rule: Screening starts at unperturbed Bragg 1030nm. Final outer design changes period only after independently closing the actual lowest sampled pole, to target actual emission 1030 +/-0.01nm. The resulting physical period is then fixed for all competing modes and TE families.

pump_comparisons.power_definition: total internal first-entry W across both 300um x 500nm gain-edge faces
internal first-entry W over the common 300um x 300um top face

far_field: complex Ex/Ey emission from each actual finite eigenfield; +/-1 degree window only when the original envelope sampling supports it
polarization: common pcselsim.polarization module; angular trapezoid integration; S3=+2 Im(Ex Ey*); no handedness label
scope: Scalar weak-modulation TE CWT; six independent retained waves for triangular lattice; same stratified Green kernel for damping and flux; shared x-z inversion with y averaged. Not full-vector Maxwell, TM, thermal or dynamic stability certification.
final_census: Residual-verified complete coarse QZ (square N17, triangular N9) lowest40, analytic continuous counterpropagating stripe challenges with high perpendicular seeds, Gamma and wide supplements; fixed-period independently closed modes and shared inversion; bounded sampled spectrum only
legacy_rule_name_note: Earlier YAG rule name swapped span/gap in its text; numeric JSON fields and actual computation have always been gap40nm and caliper50nm, identical to semiconductor rules. Frozen square_v2 metadata retains the original label for hash stability.
